$comment: Helmward revision registry. Single source of truth for what has shipped at what revision. Live verification runs on CT201 (tools/verify_revisions.py) and stamps verdict + last_verified for probe-class lines. Build-time verification runs on Netlify against this committed data only: a probe-class line may render only if verdict == passed and last_verified is within staleness_days; an asserted-class line may render only if asserted_on is within assertion_staleness_days, and MUST render with a visible 'asserted, not verified' label.

lines.statement: A zero-model probe independently checks agent-claimed results before a task resolves as done.

next.statement: Probe types beyond shell: HTTP check, SQL query, CI action.

lines.last_probe_command: cd /root/helmward-core && python3 -m pytest tests/test_verification.py -q; echo PROBE_EXIT_CODE:$?

lines.statement: Tasks persist with retries and dead-lettering; dispatch is pull-only.
lines.spec_weakness: doctor.py exits 0 on WARN, so this passes with warnings present. Tighten to a spec that asserts zero warnings, or narrow to a queue-specific probe.

lines.statement: The gate's pure logic is published to PyPI and installable independently of Helmward.

next.statement: Ships a curated library of validated spec templates.

lines.last_probe_command: python3 -m pip download attested==0.0.1 -d /tmp/attested-probe --no-deps -q; echo PROBE_EXIT_CODE:$?

lines.statement: Work is assigned by declared capability; agents claim it by polling. Manual assignment, not automatic routing.
lines.spec_note: Must run as a direct subprocess (this is how verify_revisions.py invokes every acceptance command), never dispatched as a Helmward task itself. With one online agent at concurrency_limit=1, wrapping the outer script in a task of the same capability it probes causes the agent to compete with itself -- confirmed empirically 2026-07-27.

lines.asserted_basis: Not expressible in any current spec type: this is a negative claim about network egress, and every supported type asserts presence rather than absence. Basis is architectural inspection -- the control plane, agents, and llama-swap all bind to LAN addresses, and the only outbound path is the MCP bridge to the remote brain, which the statement names explicitly. Upgradeable to probe class by gate 1.1 (HTTP/egress probe types).
lines.statement: Execution, data, agents and inference run on your hardware. The orchestrating brain is remote (Claude via MCP).
lines.acceptance_blocked_on: NOT EXPRESSIBLE in the current spec types. This is a negative claim about network egress; every existing type asserts that something IS present, none can assert that nothing left the network. Needs the gate-1.1 assumption drop (probe types beyond shell) or an explicit egress-capture probe.

next.statement: The brain slot can be filled by a model running on your hardware; nothing leaves the network.

lines.statement: The planning brain is a slot reached over MCP. Claude is the supported and tested occupant.
lines.acceptance_blocked_on: Produced by Phase 1.2. 'Supported' must mean an automated check drives a task through the gate end to end, per the support-burden rule. Until the harness exists, this line has no spec.

next.statement: Additional supported occupants: a local open-weight model, and any cloud model via OpenRouter.

lines.statement: A shared wiki is queryable on demand by any agent.
lines.content_caveat: Content is thin (concepts/=1 file, entities/=1 file). The line is honest about existence, not volume -- do not render this as 'memory that compounds'.

next.statement: A remembered fact carries its own check and a timestamp; retrieval re-runs a stale check before an agent acts on it.
